name: Advanced Topics in Sociology
description: This course is designed to introduce pre PhD students to an in-depth exposure to a selected sub-field within the discipline of sociology. The topic will be announced by the instructor teaching the course. Students will be expected to read and synthesise advanced texts of a theoretical and ethnographic nature, to understand how arguments are constructed, and how evidence is presented within the discipline. Alongside equipping students with advanced knowledge about the chosen disciplinary sub-field, the course is thus also designed to enable students to learn to work with sociological and anthropological data, read texts and synthesise arguments from a variety of sources and learn to start formulating research questions as a preparatory step to undertaking independent research.
